contract: Strong and live-map/live-key ephemeron least fixed point; safety, completeness and abstract termination.

The exact generic production driver terminates and clears waiting state, conditional on the three EphemeronTrace adapter contracts. Scan must provide a fresh queued node. A proved cardinality lemma derives rank decrease from drain preserving marks and marking all initial pending nodes; the rank is fixed as unmarked graph nodes.

Finite sequence projection to pending sets preserves duplicate multiplicities. Duplicate pops and fresh expansion preserve the graph work invariant; sequence draining terminates and marks the initial queue. Actual tracer edge enumeration and container operations remain separate obligations.

Exact new/is_empty/defer/activate/clear bodies: deferral appends with order and multiplicity, activation removes exactly the named bucket and returns every value, other keys are framed, and clear empties the table. Both normal and stress layouts checked. Uses vstd standard HashMap specifications for u64 and RandomState; diagnostic keys iterator and caller map/key provenance remain separate.

Exact bitmap lookup, ValueMarks::contains and scan_entries bodies: correct arena decoding, even-length entry scan terminates, preserves input queue and each waiting bucket, and appends exactly the ready/deferred sequences with multiplicity. Every nonempty pair is marked, queued or deferred; queued values have a source pair with a marked key and are unmarked. Waiting keys remain unmarked. Requires even slot length and initially unmarked waiting keys. Snapshot construction, outer cursor coverage and conditional provenance are checked separately by GC-WEAK-SCAN; establishing the caller invariant and full drain refinement remain open.

Exact normal-configuration Heap::value_marked and WeakPass::scan/clear bodies over all production record fields. Proves correct bitmap snapshot, cursor coverage, fresh queued values with marked-map/marked-key provenance, waiting-value provenance, preservation of previous entry coverage, and marked-key closure on no-more-work. Frames every heap field except the waiting table. Requires valid internal arena, marked weak-list entries, even map slots, covered old scan prefix and provenance of old waiters. Their establishment by the full tracer and graph completeness remain open; gc-stress diagnostic iterator bodies are not checked here.

Exact mark_symbol body for both EPHEMERONS choices, normal and stress layouts: sets only the selected symbol mark, preserves records/metadata, appends the exact waiting-value sequence and description edge only on first marking, removes only that key's bucket when activation is enabled, and frames every other heap field. Requires a live symbol, valid symbol arena and waiting table. Full drain dispatch, string/rope tracing, graph validity and rooting remain separate.
Exact mark_word/dead_word bit operations for all u64 inputs; preservation and disjointness.

Exact new/is_live/check/get/get_mut/mark/is_marked/mark_bits/clear_marks bodies: bounded access, fresh marks, other bits unchanged, exact borrowed bitmap view, zeroed bitmap, payload and metadata framing, in normal and gc-stress configurations. Requires live indices and consistent bitmap lengths; allocation and sweep preservation of these premises remains separate.

Exact taken/take_free bodies, normal and stress configurations: terminate, return the lowest reusable slot, exclude quarantine, set only its live bit, remove exactly that index from the finite reusable set, preserve exact free count and cursor invariant, and frame all other arena fields. Requires valid arena bitmap access, matching quarantine length, representable word indices, accurate positive free count and no reusable slot below the cursor. Actual allocation/growth/sweep/shrink establishment of these premises remains open. Actual Arena::new establishes the empty reuse invariant, and composition of actual mark/clear_marks preserves it. A constructed lifecycle witnesses two normal reuses versus skipping a stress-quarantined slot.

Exact boxed/kind/is_heap/payload_if and four heap constructors/decoders for all bit patterns; correct arena namespace and u32 payload, including constructor/decoder composition. Heap constructors produce canonical payloads; for canonical heap values, (kind, index) identity equals all-bit identity, composed with actual waiting-key activation. A noncanonical alias witness and negative checks make the representation premise explicit; preservation by all heap writers remains open. Does not prove that a decoded index is allocated or belongs to this heap.
Exact push_heap_values terminates and appends precisely the heap-valued subsequence, preserving the previous queue and input order/multiplicity.

All nine RootStack methods and Handles create/get/set/release/live_count preserve their exact sequence/free-list invariants. Caller must supply valid marks/indices, nonempty handle values, active handles, and representable slot counts. Does not prove Handles::values iterator, derived Default implementation, or callers' lifetime/heap ownership discipline.

Actual Roots::trace composes the three explicit stores with the source heap-value filter: exact queue-prefix preservation, store order and multiplicity, and iff membership for every heap value. RootStack/Handles/Roots field changes require explicit tracing-policy review. Does not prove the full mark_from_roots driver, other root sources, or caller safepoint discipline.

Actual Job::trace for every Reaction, Thenable and Call field: exact queue-prefix preservation and outgoing value sequence including arguments, with source ObjectId boxing. A closed variant/field policy rejects unreviewed schema changes. Queue traversal, job insertion and host/caller rooting remain separate obligations.
Exact skip/enqueue/wait decision; the caller must establish map liveness.
Interval split/coalesce and set-level allocation/release/quarantine preserve a disjoint partition; actual allocator tested separately.
Independent typed graph covers all current arenas and compares production marks and survivors during tests/gc-stress. Not a universal refinement proof.

Normal-configuration scan/clear source contracts are proved under explicit prefix/provenance invariants. The full drain, establishment and preservation of those invariants, complete marked-map enumeration, and refinement to driver.rs.in Graph/Work remain unproved. Runtime checks still cover the full adapter.
Production callbacks, free counts, cursor, quarantine, shrinking, payload preservation and value-heap partition are tested; full allocator refinement remains unproved.
New jobs and pruned caches reference retained nodes before sweep; the abstract root-addition and pruning lemmas are in model.rs.

Every mutator must root values needed after a safepoint. Explicit root-store and per-Job enumeration have source proofs; the remaining sources and the complete root driver are independently runtime-checked. Neither these local proofs nor the model proves all callers follow the rule.

The abstract graph is immutable during marking. Individual arena marking operations have record/metadata frame proofs, and normal WeakPass scan/clear frame the full Heap record except waiting storage. Content preservation across the complete tracer, weak cleanup and sweep is still unproved; interior mutable referents are not covered by record equality alone.
Finite well-formed heap, representable indices, sufficient host memory for collector work buffers, no concurrent mutator or callback during marking. This is not an OOM/heap-cap proof.
